parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Differentiate to obtain $\frac43x^{-1/3}-x^{-2/3}$. B1. Expect $x^{-2/3}(\frac43x^{1/3}-1)$ (OE). Allow $2x^{2/3}-3x^{1/3}+1$ rewritten as a quadratic in $x^{1/3}$ or $x^{-1/3}$.
Equate first derivative to zero and reach a solution for $x^{1/3}$ or $x^{-1/3}$ with no error in use of indices, or complete square to find minimum point $2(a-\frac34)^2-\frac18$ where $a=x^{1/3}$. M1. Substitution SOI if dealt with correctly later.
Obtain $x=\frac{27}{64}$. A1. Or exact equivalent. SC B1 if no working shown. Ignore extra solution $x=0$.
$y=-\frac18$ seen. B1. Or exact equivalent; allow $-0.125$.
Total: 4

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Recognise equation as quadratic in $x^{1/3}$ or equivalent and attempt solution: $2a^2-3a+1[=0]$ where $a=x^{1/3}$. M1.
Obtain $x^{1/3}=1$ and $x^{1/3}=\frac12$. A1 (OE). SC B1 if no M mark awarded.
Obtain 1 and $\frac18$. A1. SC B1 if no M mark awarded.
Integrate to obtain form $k_1x^{5/3}+k_2x^{4/3}+x$ or 2 out of 3 correct terms. *M1. Expect $\frac65x^{5/3}-\frac94x^{4/3}+x$.
Obtain correct $\frac65x^{5/3}-\frac94x^{4/3}+x$. A1. No other terms from a second integral.
Apply their limits correctly. DM1. Their limits must be from their working.
Obtain $-0.5$ and conclude area is $0.5$. A1.
Total: 7
